author: nihtscua

english.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

jyutping: jat1、ji6、saam1、sei3、ng5、luk6、cat1、baat3、gau2、sap6。
text: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The smallest child knows such a simple thing.

jyutping: gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 saam1 seoi3 sai3 lou6 dou1 sik1 laa1。
text: 咁簡單嘅嘢三歲細路都識啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.

jyutping: go2 dou6 di1 fung1 ging2 zan1 hai6 leng3 dou3 m4 zi1 dim2 jing4 jung4。
text: 嗰度啲風景真係靚到唔知點形容。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wish I had treated the girl more kindly.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 hau6 fui3 ji5 cin4 mou4 hou2 hou2 gam3 deoi3 keoi5。
text: 我好後悔以前無好好咁對佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It will take him two hours to finish the work.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 jiu3 jung6 loeng4 nap1 zung1 sin1 zi3 zou6 dak1 saai3 di1 je5。
text: 我諗佢要用兩粒鐘先至做得晒啲嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Have you finished cleaning your room yet?

jyutping: nei5 zap1 hou2 nei5 gaan1 fong4 mei6 aa3？
text: 你執好你間房未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Have you finished packing yet?

jyutping: nei5 zap1 hou2 saai3 di1 je5 mei6 aa3？
text: 你執好晒啲嘢未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's eight o'clock in the morning.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 ziu1 tau4 zou2 baat3 dim2。
text: 而家係朝頭早八點。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You have a lot of money, and I have none.

jyutping: nei5 jau5 hou2 do1 cin4，daan6 hai6 ngo5 zau6 mou5。
text: 你有好多錢，但係我就冇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you flunk this exam, you'll have to repeat the course.

jyutping: nei5 caau2 zo2 ni1 go3 haau2 si3 zau6 jiu3 cung4 duk6 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你炒咗呢個考試就要重讀㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will you show me what you bought?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa2 nei5 maai5 zo2 di1 me1 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以俾我睇吓你買咗啲咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think he's not over his ex.

jyutping: keoi5 jing1 goi1 zung6 mei6 fong3 dak1 dai1 keoi5 cin4 dou6。
text: 佢應該仲未放得低佢前度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's always looking at you. He must love you.

jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gap6 sat6 nei5，zung6 m4 hai6 lam1 nei5？
text: 佢成日𥄫實你，仲唔係冧你？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom isn't the only one here who's a good singer.

jyutping: ne1 dou3 ceoi4 zo2 aa3 Tom zi1 ngoi6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 hou2 hou2 teng1。
text: 呢到除咗阿Tom之外仲有好多人唱歌唱得好好聽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you take a child outside and point at the moon, they will look at the moon. If you do the same thing with a dog, it will look at your finger.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 daai2 go3 sai3 lou6 ceot1 gaai1，zi2 zyu6 go3 jyut6 loeng6，keoi5 wui5 mong6 zyu6 go3 jyut6 loeng6。jyu4 gwo2 nei5 deoi3 zek3 gau2 zou6 tung4 joeng6 ge2 je5，keoi5 wui5 mong6 zyu6 nei5 zek3 sau2 zi2。
text: 如果你帶個細路出街，指住個月亮，佢會望住個月亮。如果你對隻狗做同樣嘅嘢，佢會望住你隻手指。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why do people say 'tuna fish' but not 'beef mammal' or 'chicken bird'?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 tan1 naa4 jyu2 giu3 zou6「tan1 naa4 jyu2」，daan6 hai6 ngau4 jau6 m4 wui5 giu3 zou6「ngau4 bou6 jyu5 dung6 mat6」、gai1 jau6 m4 wui5 giu3 zou6「gai1 zoek3 zai2」ge2？
text: 點解吞拿魚叫做「吞拿魚」，但係牛又唔會叫做「牛哺乳動物」、雞又唔會叫做「雞雀仔」嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll never forget the day when we first met.

jyutping: ngo5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 m4 gei3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 go2 jat6。
text: 我永遠都唔會唔記得我哋第一次見面嗰日。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can't pick who you fall in love with.

jyutping: nei5 mou5 dak1 gaan2 zi6 gei2 wui5 zung1 ji3 bin1 go3。
text: 你冇得揀自己會鍾意邊個。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I won't forgive you if you do that again.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zoi3 gam3 zou6，ngo5 m4 wui6 jyun4 loeng6 nei5。
text: 如果你再咁做，我唔會原諒你。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom returned me all the textbooks apart from a dictionary.

jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 bun2 zi6 din2，aa3 tong1 mat1 syu1 dou1 waan4 saai3 bei2 ngo5。
text: 除咗本字典，阿湯乜書都還曬畀我。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Gasoline became so expensive that we had to let our car go.
Oil prices have been getting more expensive, I think I should sell my car.

jyutping: di1 jau2 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gwai3，ngo5 dang2 zi2 hou2 maai6 zo2 gaa3 ce1。
text: 啲油越來越貴，我等只好賣咗架車。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Honestly, I think if Mary had admitted she knew damn well what she was doing, and was understandably guilty about that, I'd have more sympathy for her. Altruism and self-sacrifice are fine to talk about, but actually being willing to give up your life for someone else—which is probably what refusing to rat people out to the bad guys would have come to, for her—is a pretty tall order. Not everyone is that brave, and being forced into a position where she had to choose between her own life and the lives of the people around her was a miserable and unfair position the villains are responsible for putting her in. She didn't do it unprompted.

jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2，jyu4 gwo2 Mary sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 kei4 sat6 hou2 cing1 co2 zi6 gei2 zou6 gan2 mat1，tung4 si4 jan1 wai6 ni1 gin6 si6 gok3 dak1 noi6 gau3，ngo5 wui5 deoi3 keoi5 do1 di1 tung4 cing4。gong2 altruism tung4 self-sacrifice dong1 jin4 jung4 ji6，daan6 zan1 hai6 jyun6 ji3 wai6 zo2 kei4 taa1 jan4 hei1 sang1 zi6 gei2 tiu4 meng6——keoi5 zyut6 hoeng3 waai6 jan4 ceot1 maai6 kei4 taa1 jan4，han2 daai6 gei1 wui6 zau6 hai6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 ni1 go3 doi6 gaa3——ni1 go3 jiu1 kau4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1。m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 gam3 daai6 jung5 hei3，ji4 keoi5 bei6 bik1 lok6 dou3 jiu3 hai2 zi6 gei2 tiu4 meng6 tung4 san1 bin1 jan4 tiu4 meng6 zi1 gaan1 gaan2 jat1 go3 ge3 caam2 fong3，jyun4 cyun4 hai6 ok3 gwan3 bik1 keoi5 jap6 guk6 ge3，m4 gung1 ping4。keoi5 m4 hai6 zyu2 dung6、mou4 dyun1 dyun1 gam3 zou6 ge3。
text: 老實講，如果Mary承認自己其實好清楚自己做緊乜，同時因為呢件事覺得內疚，我會對佢多啲同情。講 altruism 同 self-sacrifice 當然容易，但真係願意為咗其他人犧牲自己條命——拒絕向壞人出賣其他人，很大機會就係要付出呢個代價——呢個要求真係好高。唔係人人都有咁大勇氣，而佢被逼落到要喺自己條命同身邊人條命之間揀一個嘅慘況，完全係惡棍逼佢入局嘅，唔公平。佢唔係主動、無端端咁做嘅。
